title: Fantasy Footballers’ Andy Holloway is a dedicated zero-inbox kinda guy

llm_summary: Andy Holloway, one of the three co‑hosts of the wildly popular *Fantasy Footballers* podcast, is famously obsessive about keeping his email inbox empty—he treats zero‑inbox as a productivity hack. The show, which he runs alongside Jason Moore and Mike Wright, draws over 2 million listeners a month and has racked up multiple awards, including iHeartRadio’s Best Sports Podcast and four consecutive People’s Choice Podcast Awards.
